question: Should unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes become a default-on 30-minute fallback, or should periodic sync remain opt-in for existing users?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but changing a disabled default to background periodic indexing is a compatibility and operator-impact policy choice that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve default-on after scoped repair
options.body: Keep the 30-minute default, guard the dirty mark to memory-source managers, and treat the added background work as an intentional freshness tradeoff.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Preserve the 0 default and document intervalMinutes: 30 or doctor guidance as the workaround for users who need watcher-failure resilience.

options.title: Choose a narrower default policy
options.body: Default periodic sync only for a maintainer-approved mode, such as gateway or watcher-enabled memory configurations, and add upgrade proof for that policy.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on after scoped repair
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-minute default, guard the dirty mark to memory-source managers, and treat the added background work as an intentional freshness tradeoff.
